description: List issues, optionally filtered by status, priority, assignee, sprint_id, or tag.

status.description: Optional: open, in_progress, in_review, resolved, closed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of issue summaries.

description: Retrieve the full issue record by iid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full issue including description and timestamps.

description: Create a new issue in status=open.

priority.description: Priority: low, medium, high, critical (default medium).

issue_type.description: Type: bug, feature, or task (default task).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new issue summary.

description: Update one or more fields on an existing issue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated issue summary.

description: Delete an issue and all its comments.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output contains iid, deleted, and removed_comments count.

description: Assign an issue to a user.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated issue summary.

description: Change the status of an issue.

status.description: New status: open, in_progress, in_review, resolved, closed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated issue summary.

description: Change the priority of an issue.

priority.description: New priority: low, medium, high, critical.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated issue summary.

description: Attach an issue to a sprint.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated issue summary.

description: Detach an issue from its current sprint (returns to backlog).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated issue summary.

description: List all sprints sorted by start_date.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of sprint summaries.

description: Retrieve the full sprint record by sid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full sprint.

description: Create a new upcoming sprint.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new sprint summary.

description: Transition a sprint to active status.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated sprint summary.

description: Mark a sprint as completed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated sprint summary.

description: List all issues attached to a given sprint.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of issue summaries.

description: Add a comment to an issue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new comment.

description: List all comments on an issue sorted by created_at.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of comments.

description: Search issues by keyword across title, description, and tags.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching issue summaries sorted by recency.

description: List issues that are unassigned to a sprint and not yet resolved or closed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of backlog issue summaries.

description: Aggregate stats: issues, sprints, comments, backlog size, breakdowns by status, priority, and type.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a stats object.
